messages:
elaine: Quick check-in: AWS Marketplace intake in ~6 weeks. Partner security asked for SAML SSO + SCIM + KMS guidance for the listing and joint announcement. Who can own?
kai: I can take the tech spec for SAML/SCIM and KMS BYOK flow. Will include sample metadata and a key-policy snippet.
maya: Product needs a small feature matrix (hosted/dedicated/private) and a customer checklist for onboarding. I'll draft the matrix.
shaun: Legal will draft announcement-safe language and a compliance checklist. No attestations implied.
liam: Marketplace needs 3 screenshots, a short security blurb, and a partner contact. I'll reach out to AWS for screenshot specs.
marketplace-bizdev-bot: "Listing intake opens 2026-11-05. Upload assets by 2026-11-01."
elaine: Plan: kai tech spec, maya checklist + matrix, shaun announcement, liam marketplace assets. Target: deliverables 2 weeks before intake.
kai: Note: for BYOK in Dedicated we must document rotation without KV-cache downtime. I'll add migration steps.
maya: Add rotation risk/mitigation to the checklist.
shaun: I'll post draft announcement here for review tomorrow.
liam: Scheduling AWS sync for next Mon 09:00 PT. Invite sent.
elaine: Thanks all. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
